data.title: Seascape at Rashid Yachts & Marina
data.about:
The ultimate blend of luxury, style, and elegance, with spectacular views of the Marina and the blue horizon of the Arabian Gulf. This is your coastal luxury paradise. 

You may spend lengthy holidays taking in the breathtaking mix of sunny weather, world-class shopping, modern architecture, sandy beaches, and the most cosmopolitan way of life. These homes comprise 1 to 3 Bedroom apartments and townhouses built to represent the ideal modern waterfront architecture, combining luxury housing with a distinct notion of “living at sea.”
